name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.89 / build 90 packages the aligned Medical Form History arrow/title with a larger back target, fitted submitted-form heading and school-ID review preview. Existing forms, read-only multi-service medical results, photos, direct Android PDF downloads, legal notices and staff support are retained. TypeScript, focused header/navigation checks and 36 offline header layouts passed. The wider UI suite has two confirmed pre-existing unrelated failures. Actual package version, signing continuity, all 129 source-manifest files, eight native modules and both clinic PDF templates were verified; 37 previous APKs were preserved. This publication does not deploy the backend, provision private storage, enable billing, reset data or delete accounts/records. Result attachments require the matching backend and approved private storage. Existing development/test signing retained; no physical-phone installation or production/Play Store signing is claimed. Install over a compatible app without uninstalling or clearing data.
